query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

content.text:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

🎉 **So Long, Stephen — But What a Ride!** 🎉

They say the best engineers don't just fix problems — they *prevent* them, **meme** about them, and then fix them anyway. Stephen, you did all three, and you did it with style! 😄

Your code was clean, your solutions were brilliant, and your memes? *Chef's kiss.* 👨‍🍳💋 You didn't just make us laugh — you made Mondays survivable. And honestly, that might be your greatest engineering feat of all.

As you close this chapter and open an exciting new one, remember: **the best is always yet to come.** You've got the skills, the wit, and clearly the meme folder to conquer whatever comes next. 🚀

We'll miss your commits, your clever fixes, and yes — your legendary meme game. But we know the world out there is about to get a whole lot more brilliant (and funnier) because of you.

**Go build something amazing, Stephen. We're rooting for you! 🌟**

*"It's not a goodbye — it's just a git push to a new repository."* 😄

---

Wishing you all the best on your next adventure! 🥂
